tools.name: place_orders
tools.description: Place up to 25 orders in one go — several services, one link or several — paid together from the balance. THIS SPENDS THE USER'S REAL BALANCE (USD) and starts delivery. Use it when the user wants several things at once (e.g. followers + likes + views for one account); for one order use place_order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Status and progress of one order: status (pending, processing, completed, partial, refunded, cancelled, failed), start count, delivered, remains, charge and refunds in USD, and whether it can be cancelled now.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: The user's orders, newest first. Filter by status; page with `before` = the smallest order number already seen.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Ask to cancel a pending or processing order (only when the order says cancelable: true). Whatever was not delivered is refunded to the balance in USD. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The user's spendable balance in USD. Orders are paid from it.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: The user's automations, newest first, with progress (runs placed, delivered), spend against budget and the next run. Filter by status.

tools.name: get_automation
tools.description: One automation with its timeline: every run, the order it placed and what that delivered, or why a run waits or was skipped (balance, budget, a daily limit).

tools.name: pause_automation
tools.description: Stop placing new runs until it is resumed (orders already running keep delivering). Nothing is charged while paused.

tools.name: resume_automation
tools.description: Carry on with a paused automation: the rest of the plan moves by the time it was paused. After a price change, resuming accepts the new price for the runs left — tell the user first.

tools.name: cancel_automation
tools.description: Stop an automation for good: every future run is cancelled. Orders already running finish, unless cancel_running: true asks those that allow it to cancel too (the undelivered part is refunded). Confirm with the user first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation · Private data: find_services, create_automation · Public sink: find_services, place_order, get_top_up_info, create_automation · Destructive: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation, list_automations, get_automation, cancel_automation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation · Private data: find_services, create_automation · Public sink: find_services, place_order, get_top_up_info, create_automation · Destructive: find_services, get_quote, place_order, create_automation, list_automations, get_automation, cancel_automation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
